linkGone.title: This link is no longer available
linkGone.askNew: Ask whoever sent it to you for a new one.

auth.headline: Your vehicle on the map, live.
auth.pitch: Create your account, add your GPS device and watch it move. It's open and free: it works with Teltonika, Concox, SinoTrack, Coban, Queclink, Suntech and more.

login.title: Sign in to your account
login.linkFailed: This link is no longer valid. Sign in with your email and password, and we'll send you a new one.
login.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. You can now sign in with the new one.

register.title: Create your account
register.lead: Free, no card needed. Then add your GPS device in two minutes.
register.mustAccept: To create your account you need to accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.
register.closed: Sign-up for new accounts is closed. Only people who received an invitation by email can sign up.
register.name: Your name
register.accept: I accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

services.notLinked: There is already an account with that email, but the service does not confirm it is yours. Sign in with your password.
services.noEmail: The service did not share your email. Allow it when signing in, or use another one.
services.cancelled: You cancelled signing in with the service.
services.failed: Could not sign in with that service. Try again.
services.terms: If you do not have an account yet, it is created when you continue. By doing so you accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.sent: We sent an email to {{email}}. If the account is new, open it to confirm it and you'll go straight in; if you already had one with that email, it tells you how to sign in.
checkEmail.resent: Your account isn't confirmed yet. We sent the link again to {{email}}. Open it and you'll go straight to your account.
checkEmail.slow: It may take a minute. Check your spam folder too.
checkEmail.resendFailed: We couldn't resend it. Try again in a moment.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter your account's email and we'll send you a link to create a new one.
forgot.sent: If that email has an account, the link is on its way. It expires in 1 hour.

reset.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
reset.invalidText: Password reset links expire in 1 hour and work only once.
reset.title: Create a new password

appSignIn.title: Sign in to the app
appSignIn.lead: You're about to sign in to the app with {{email}}.
appSignIn.notYou: If you weren't signing in from the app, stop here: cancel or close this page.
appSignIn.failed: Couldn't go back to the app. Try again.
appSignIn.expired: This sign-in is no longer valid. Go back to the app and try again.
appSignIn.passkeyLead: Use Face ID, your fingerprint or the QR code of another phone to go back to the app with your account.

appPasskey.title: Create a passkey
appPasskey.lead: For {{email}}. Use Face ID, Touch ID or your fingerprint; then go back to the app and sign in with “Sign in with a passkey”.
appPasskey.unavailable: This platform or this browser cannot create passkeys.

delivery.failedText: Contact whoever sent you this link to arrange it again.
delivery.rescheduledText: Contact whoever sent you this link.
delivery.legend: The red dot is the delivery location. The vehicle is shown while it's on its way.

driver.actionFailed: We couldn't complete that. Check your connection and try again.
driver.unattended_one: {{count}} stop not handled: it will be marked as skipped.
driver.unattended_other: {{count}} stops not handled: they will be marked as skipped.

sheet.whyMissing: Write why it couldn't be delivered.
sheet.recordFailed: Record that it couldn't be delivered

invitation.title: Invitation
invitation.notFoundText: It may have been withdrawn. Ask whoever invited you to send you another one.
invitation.expired: This invitation expired. Ask whoever invited you to send you another one.
invitation.lead: {{inviter}} invited you to see their vehicles as {{role}}.
invitation.forEmail: The invitation is for {{email}}. Sign in with that email or create your account with it.
invitation.otherEmail: The invitation is for {{email}}, and you're signed in as {{current}}. Sign out and sign in with the invited email.
invitation.ownAccount: Your own account is still there: you can switch between the two from your profile menu.

sharedLocation.title: Shared location
sharedLocation.gone: It may have expired or been withdrawn. Ask whoever sent it to you for a new one.
sharedLocation.loadFailed: We couldn't load the location. Retrying…
sharedLocation.noReport: This vehicle's GPS device hasn't reported yet.
